findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?tools=user_info,web_unlocker,google_serp,yandex_serp,duckduckgo_serp,bing_serp,amazon,youtube,facebook,instagram,reddit,walmart,google,booking,indeed,airbnb,google_play_store,github,tiktok,linkedin,glassdoor,twitter,crunchbase,zillow,ebay,chatgpt" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: booking_hotellist_by_url, facebook_event_by_search_url, github_repository_by_search_url, google_search, indeed_companies_info_by_company_list_url, linkedin_job_listings_information_by_job_url, youtube_video_post_by_podcast_url, youtube_video_post_by_search_filters · Private data: query_user_api_keys, query_user_info, youtube_audio_by_url, youtube_video_by_url · Public sink: facebook_comment_by_comments_url, facebook_post_by_posts_url, ins_comment_by_posturl, reddit_comment_by_url, twitter_post_by_profileurl, youtube_video_post_by_explore, youtube_video_post_by_hashtag, youtube_video_post_by_keyword, youtube_video_post_by_podcast_url, youtube_video_post_by_search_filters, youtube_video_post_by_url.
